# The Web3 Wizard Labs

> Founder-led AI-native Web3 product studio by Khalid Murtala. We turn real Web3 problems and roadmap milestones into focused, working products: AI agents, Solana applications, dApps, automation tools, and Web3 MVPs.

## About
The Web3 Wizard (The Web3 Wizard Labs) is a solo studio, not an agency. Khalid Murtala directs every engagement — from architecture to handover — with AI-native execution and human accountability. We build the smallest useful product, with visible deliverables and documented limitations.

## Services
- [Product Discovery Sprint](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/services/product-discovery): Turn a Web3 problem or idea into a build-ready product direction. Define the user, scope the MVP, and decide what to build first. For founders who need clarity before committing to a build.
- [Web3 MVP Development](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/services/web3-mvp-development): Build a focused, working Web3 product. AI agents, Solana applications, dApps, automation tools, and Web3 MVPs built by a founder-led AI-native studio.
- [AI Agent & Solana Engineering](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/services/ai-agent-solana-engineering): Specialist capability for AI agents, autonomous workflows, Telegram/Discord tools, Solana integrations, on-chain data pipelines, and AI-powered product features.

## Work — Founder-Built Projects
- [Valor — AI Agent for Telegram](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/valor): Autonomous conversational agent for Web3 communities. Live at https://valor-tgbot.vercel.app — GitHub https://github.com/theweb3wizard/Valor
- [WalletLens — EVM Wallet Intelligence](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/walletlens): Query Ethereum, Polygon, BNB, Arbitrum, Base wallets in plain English. Live at https://walletlens-hq.vercel.app
- [Write3 — AI Web3 Content Generator](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/write3): Generate Web3-native content for X, Discord, Telegram, Farcaster, blogs. Live at https://write3-ai.vercel.app
- [AgentHub — Secure AI Agent Access Layer](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/agenthub): Policy-controlled access to DBs/APIs/infra with audit trails. Live at https://agenthub-lyart.vercel.app
- [OrderFlow — AI Trading Journal on Injective](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/orderflow): Reads on-chain history to show where you leak money. Live at https://orderflow-hq.vercel.app
- [SolPulse — Solana Wallet Monitoring](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/solpulse): Solana on-chain signals via Telegram
- [Community Signal — Web3 Community Action Tool](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work/community-signal): Building-stage experiment for turning community activity into a clear next action
- [All Work](https://www.theweb3wizard.xyz/work): Portfolio overview
